title: Packages renamed or replaced for newer versions
description: Referenced packages that are deprecated on NuGet with an alternate package, or that the package knowledge maps to a successor.

impact.summary: The successor package must be verified for the target from its own metadata.

handling.option: Move to the successor named by the package metadata, verified for the target

sources.evidence: This article will cover the process of installing as well as uninstalling packages from your Umbraco CMS website

checks.text: Each successor package resolves for the target framework and the site builds
